name: Epii / Antichrist — Episode 1.0: "The Naked Face" (whole)
description: Episode 1.0 as a whole-story sequence: its ten movements in order, open poem through quilting return, so the ending qualifies the beginning (whole-first law). QL Position #1 — Split / Genesis / Differentiation. Source: antichrist-vault/episodes/1/ep-0.1-(now-ep-1.0)/Episode_0_1_The_Naked_Face_v9.md (EpiLogos/research-canvas at 7df35f822f9235331a69940cdaf484fe4a0b95c1, byte-identical to published origin/main). Scene texts carry faithful compression; READ-block titles are carried verbatim; all visuals are declared presentation mappings, not source claims. Binding: bindings/epii-ep1-naked-face.binding.json. Corpus: epii-antichrist.

scenes.name: Movement 1 — The Poem, open
scenes.character: QL Position #1 — Split / Genesis / Differentiation. The series opens with a read poem.

text.title: The Poem — open
text.body: An opening poem, read. The definitive episode on what an archetype is begins in song, not argument — the poem returns at the quilting close.

scenes.name: Movement 2 — The Sun, definitional ground
scenes.character: The sun/solar system as central image; three nested QL units embedded within that image.

text.title: The Sun — definitional ground
text.body: Jung's buried lead. The as-such / image distinction. Psychic facticity — the fact of dawn. The spectral / harmonic principle. The mono-poly. Need. The solar system as QL structure.

scenes.name: Movement 3 — The Antichrist defined
scenes.character: READ — "What Is the Anti-Christ?" — then "The Emptiness of the Symbol".

text.title: The Antichrist defined
text.body: Two read blocks define the term against its cultural caricature: what the Anti-Christ is, and what the symbol must be emptied of before it can carry the archetype.

scenes.name: Movement 4 — The Devil's sixfold
scenes.character: Sacrifice and the direction of flow; the sixfold rooted in the Antagonist.

text.title: The Devil's sixfold
text.italic: sacrifice and the direction of flow
text.body: Sacrifice as the essential verb. The sixfold rooted in the Antagonist. The Venus dynamic. The Pan revelation: the feeder was always the deepest identity of the devourer.

scenes.name: Movement 5 — The Book's portraits
scenes.character: Four read portraits; the spectral principle held as plates, not a single image.

text.title: The Book's portraits
text.italic: no single image exhausts the Devil
text.body: READ from the Book: the Showman, the Record Keeper, the Gifted Child, the Hermaphrodite — and why the Devil needs compassion. A spectral portrait, the way a chord is richer than any of its notes.

scenes.name: Movement 6 — The architecture of power
scenes.character: The work/play inversion; the concentric rings; the accounting of power.

text.title: The architecture of power
text.body: The exercising and the exorcising of power as the two strands of one relation. The concentric rings of identity and belonging; the accounting of power.

scenes.name: Movement 7 — Why this matters now
scenes.character: The psyop; the schizophrenic whole; how to approach the collective psyche.

text.title: Why this matters now
text.body: The psyop as spectral exploitation. The schizophrenic whole of the modern mind. How do we approach the collective psyche? Interpret it as a dream: assume the dreamer knew more than you do.

scenes.name: Movement 8 — The archetype-as-such
scenes.character: The irrepresentable ground: three read blocks on division, formlessness and anti-spectral rigidity.

text.title: The archetype-as-such
text.body: READ: The Divided Individual. The Fear of Formlessness. The Anti-Spectral Rigidity. The archetype-as-such is irrepresentable; the images orbit it like planets orbit the sun.

scenes.name: Movement 9 — Language as harmonic medium
scenes.character: Utterance as spectral image of the ground.

text.title: Language as harmonic medium
text.body: Language does not describe the field from outside; it is one of the field's own harmonics — naming as the whole QL unit firing at once.

scenes.name: Movement 10 — The quilting return
scenes.character: The close returns to the opening poem; the whole held as one.

text.title: The Naked Face — quilting return
text.body: The quilting return and personal testimony: every motif of the episode gathered back to the opening poem's O. The whole story, held as one.
